notes.title: Assets Reverted Update! (DS arts is back on action!)
notes.notes: This update has Rave Heart reverted back to the beauty of the human-made DS arts assets for people to enjoy! ^_^

notes.title: Hotfix patch v 7.1
notes.notes:
- ATLAS Starship traveling sequences are now made faster.
- Some small bugs with chests appear when they're not supposed to have been fixed.
- Buffed some of the bosses' difficulty a bit.

notes.title: Hotfix Update!
notes.notes:
- Bug Fixed on Victory Screen error upon last killing an enemy with poison. 

Special thanks to KK20 for helping me diagnose and look for the root cause of the problem, as well as providing a fix for it. Special thanks to Breyer600 and Hard Reset for encountering the bug and reporting them asap.

- Bug Fixed on game freeze whenever certain enemies with only spells as their battle commands get Muted/Silenced.

Special thanks to Breyer600 for reporting this.

- Fixed some typos.
